calls.reason: The best pre-2022 candidate, Li, Nye & Andreas (2021), recovered full states only 53.8% of the time, and its authors leave the link to model behaviour open. The chess study succeeds, but on chess notation, not natural language.

One 2021 BERT-extension paper builds predictive-coding theory into training, which dents the absolute 'ignores all'. It is a niche case, and nothing shows uptake in mainstream LLMs, so the evidence is mixed.

The evidence is only philosophical argument on both sides: Bender & Koller (2020) for, Mandelkern & Linzen (2024) against, with no decisive answer. No measurement of reference or world-model updating in 2022 systems was found.
